prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+5.1% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests while 2 showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally overestimated for failed or neutral tests, but underestimated performance on winning tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -8.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +5.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -7.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +5.1% after noise correction, 5 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact upload layout redesign with photo preview: Redesign the upload_photos screen into a compact layout with a live photo preview container to help users upload high quality pet photos easily. (why: Adoption step has high drop-off (70.8% completion, 1017s mean time) and support reported custom pet creation issues.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Companion mascot greeting screen before desktop reveal: Insert a new companion greeting screen right before home_intro to introduce the pet's character. (why: Finish screen completion drops to 64.8% with high mean time (5815s), needing an engaging transition into the desktop environment.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Story scroll intro redesign: Redesign the initial story screen using a story_scroll layout featuring option preview cards before path selection. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is high (514s), indicating users take long to decide how to start.)
3: [home, new_flow] Generation wait flow video preview: Enhance the waiting screen with a video asset preview showing what the pet can do on the desktop while generation completes. (why: Home target step drop-off and long waiting time (201s median) lead to user confusion during pet creation.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account pet safety copy on sign-in screen: Update headline and body on sign_in to explicitly explain that signing in backs up the pet and prevents progress loss. (why: Support theme highlights 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption certificate progress tracking info: Enable progress bars and step counters on the adoption certificate screen to clarify adoption status. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the early funnel (70.8%).)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop pet control interactions hint: Add an explicit interactive hint on home_intro explaining how to click, drag, hide, or talk to the pet on desktop. (why: Support emails show confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after setup.)
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path selection feature badges: Add emphasis and visual badges to choice options on choose_path screen highlighting instant play vs custom pet path. (why: Reduces decision friction on choose_path where mean duration reaches 514s.)
8: [sign_in, notification] Sign-in progress notification indicator: Add a progress bar and sync confirmation hint to sign_in to reassure users their pet configuration is safe. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in stalling or screen failing to appear properly.)
9: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after photo upload step: Reorder the sign-in step to appear immediately after pet photo upload instead of before pet creation. (why: Reordering sign-in after investment steps consistently improved conversion (+5.1% average in earlier tests).)

scores.note: Target step has high drop-off and support issues, but past adoption redesigns performed poorly (-8.0%).
Finish step has high loss, but adding new screens at finish previously decreased conversion (-7.2%).
High time spent on choose_path, and choose_path redesign showed positive results in past test (+5.4%).
Addresses wait time in home step, but requires new assets/flow with weak historical evidence.
Strong support signal (8 emails) and low implementation cost (copy change only).
Adoption has lowest completion (70.8%); progress tracking provides clarity with low risk.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users and support emails confirm interaction confusion.
Helps decision time on choose_path with light UI updates.
Solves reported sign-in stalling confusion, though affects a smaller portion of drop-offs.
Sign-in reordering is a proven winner across 5 tests (+5.1% avg) and easy to configure.
